annotations.text: Decided 2026-09-14 — A on all four boards, plus your two notes beside board 2. Each board now opens with a green banner saying what shipped; the controls are live on /fixtures/inspector and in the catalogue. Board 5 is new: the eighteen patterns your note asked for.
